breadcrumbs.name: Breadcrumbs
breadcrumbs.purpose: Show the current location path inside one hierarchy without owning route architecture, side navigation, or page history.

anatomy.rule: Shows current location with aria-current and text emphasis, not action-primary selected styling.
Uses symbol, icon, or motion support.

variants.description: Middle items collapsed into an ellipsis.
Previous item plus current page treatment.

breadcrumbs.statePrecedence: disabled > current > collapsed > focus > hover > default

Energy.decision: Use Energy so Breadcrumbs remains a bounded component.
Energy.behavior: Breadcrumbs exposes local state without absorbing patterns.
Energy.rejectIf: Navigation architecture, route guards, and IA decisions belong to navigation patterns.

props.name: maxItems
props.notes: Maximum visible items before overflow collapse.

props.name: state
props.type: default | hover | focus | collapsed | current | disabled

props.name: fullWidth
props.notes: Allows the trail to fill its parent width.

do: Use Breadcrumbs for its bounded job.
dont: Navigation architecture, route guards, and IA decisions belong to navigation patterns.
Do not create multi-step system inside it.
Do not rely on color or motion only.
info: Escalate to patterns when orchestration appears.

agentInstructions: Use Breadcrumbs only for local component behavior.
Navigation architecture, route guards, and IA decisions belong to navigation patterns.
rejectIf: Navigation architecture, route guards, and IA decisions belong to navigation patterns.
Required label or fallback is missing.

semanticDecisions.decision: Use Flow text emphasis for aria-current page; action-primary is only for actionable ancestor hover/focus.
semanticDecisions.reason: Breadcrumbs current is location, not an interactive selected control.
semanticDecisions.test: Verify aria-current page text is not action-primary and is rendered as non-link text.
semanticDecisions.rejectIf: Current breadcrumb is styled as selected/action primary.
